breakdown.description: The follower pressures on the two holes are replaced by dead loads based on reference normals
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly states to apply the follower pressure using reference normals (which is a dead load), contradicting the term 'follower pressure'. The ground truth corrects this by specifying the use of 'current normals of the deformed hole boundaries'. The generated specification repeated the original error, stating to 'Apply follower pressure ... using the reference (undeformed) normals, not the current normals.'
